description: Database schema migration (version 5) adding all new comprehensive fields to the registrations table, plus updated helpers and config
steps: Add migration version 5 in database.php that adds the following columns to the registrations table (using the same PRAGMA table_info idempotent pattern as migration 4): eiin_number TEXT, mpo_status TEXT, establishment_year INTEGER, school_phone TEXT, school_email TEXT, school_website TEXT, division TEXT, district TEXT, upazila TEXT, union_ward TEXT, village TEXT, postal_code TEXT, num_buildings INTEGER, num_classrooms INTEGER, has_computer_lab TEXT, has_science_lab TEXT, has_library TEXT, has_playground TEXT, total_students_boys INTEGER, total_students_girls INTEGER, students_class_1 INTEGER, students_class_2 INTEGER, students_class_3 INTEGER, students_class_4 INTEGER, students_class_5 INTEGER, students_class_6 INTEGER, students_class_7 INTEGER, students_class_8 INTEGER, students_class_9 INTEGER, students_class_10 INTEGER, male_teachers INTEGER, female_teachers INTEGER, trained_teachers INTEGER, untrained_teachers INTEGER, num_computers INTEGER, has_internet TEXT, internet_type TEXT, num_projectors INTEGER, has_multimedia_classroom TEXT, existing_software TEXT, head_teacher_name TEXT, head_teacher_phone TEXT, head_teacher_whatsapp TEXT, head_teacher_email TEXT, managing_committee_chairman TEXT, managing_committee_phone TEXT

Add a new helper function institution_types(): array in helpers.php that returns the full list of valid institution types with their Bangla labels (used by both form and validation)
Update config.example.php quotas array to include the new institution types with default quota 3
acceptance_criteria: php -l database.php passes without syntax errors
php -l includes/helpers.php passes without syntax errors
php -l config.example.php passes without syntax errors
Migration version 5 follows the same idempotent PRAGMA table_info pattern as version 4
institution_types() returns an associative array of code => Bangla label for all types
institution_label() uses institution_types() internally to avoid duplication
No NID field is included anywhere - the head_teacher_nid column is NOT added
head_teacher_whatsapp field IS included for WhatsApp number
